$comment: Update policy consumed by policy plugins + core safety rails (lib/cli.js applyCoreRails). Site profiles may override keys via profile.policyOverrides.

securitySkipSoak.$comment: A security candidate with cvss >= minCvss skips patchSoakDays (tier A only).

requiresFollowUpPatch.$comment: A new minor/major line is only eligible once a follow-up patch exists. Default: x.y.1+; overrides per component.

php.comment: PHP x.y.0/x.y.1 historically ship regressions; require x.y.2+

A.description: patch within the current minor (same major.minor)

B.description: minor / major bump or runtime switch (e.g. PHP 8.3 -> 8.4, Node 22 -> 24)

select2.comment: de-facto final release of select2; rc rule intentionally bypassed

nginx.$comment: nginx.org release channel (policy: latest stable and compatible). stable = even minor; mainline (odd minor) candidates are never proposed. An installed mainline build yields a tier-B 'channel-switch' to the newest soaked stable build (patchSoakDays), applied only via an approval naming a profile adapter. Optional stableIndexUrl overrides the derived stable Packages index URL.
